goals: Preserve Matcha Crystal Heart progression as explicit semantic main-hand use instead of automatic inventory-entry consumption.

Preserve project-owned persistent maximum-health state and one-heart-per-death debt from Matcha's 30-heart cap down to the five-heart floor, with Reinforced repair only below the normal ten-heart baseline.
Own the narrow Heart, death, recipe, loot, Echo Shard discovery, and Resonant Favour crafting boundary consolidated in Canary 10 without forking Matcha or changing unrelated Matcha behavior.
scope: Recognize a Matcha Crystal Heart only as minecraft:poisonous_potato with minecraft:item_model=minecraft:heart_container; ordinary poisonous potatoes fail closed, inventory movement never applies a Heart, and use remains main-hand right-click only.

Persist sanitized even maximum-health values from 10 through 60 health points; preserve a valid adopted value, fall back to 20 for malformed, odd, or out-of-range state, add two points for a Crystal Heart only from 20 through 58, subtract two points on every death to a floor of 10, and add two points for a Reinforced Heart only below 20 with a cap of 20.

Provide the ordinary component item matcha_heart_death_compat:resonant_favour with the supplied exact sprite; craft it as four Echo Shards around Divine Favour, use it in the e e/ere/ e  Reinforced Heart recipe, and use Divine Fragment plus Divine Favour in the f f/fdf/ f  Crystal Heart recipe.

Own exactly the three established authoritative post-prepare recipe replacements, plus the packaged Resonant Favour and Reinforced recipes, two authoritative advancements, four Echo-scarcity loot tables, and the two conflicting Matcha Heart functions through the fail-closed reload seams retained from Canary 8.

Preserve Ancient City loot as the remaining unchanged Echo Shard source, Silk-Touch-only Sculk Sensor, Calibrated Sculk Sensor, and Sculk Shrieker item drops, and the existing Music Disc 5 and Swift Sneak/Soul Speed sinks.

exclusions: Forking or modifying Matcha itself, copying Matcha's Crystal Heart art, or taking ownership of unrelated Matcha datapack, resource-pack, worldgen, loot, visual, or gameplay systems.
Changing keepInventory, adding item-loss punishment, or letting Crystal Hearts repair below-baseline health or Reinforced Hearts grant bonus health.
Broad recipe, advancement, loot, or function interception beyond the exact frozen identifiers.
Co-installing the retired matcha_echo_shard_scarcity mod, failed Canary 7, or another Heart artifact with current Canary 11 or accepted Canary 10.
The separate Reach Crafting and Effortless Crafting grid-delay issue.
Dedicated-server or exhaustive runtime claims not present in the recorded evidence.
Redeploying, promoting, or reclassifying failed Canary 7, or treating Canary 10's explicitly authorized static-only baseline promotion as Minecraft runtime evidence.
